question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` become permanent public Plugin SDK API for cross-plugin progress intent, or should this signal use a narrower internal/runtime seam?
rationale: The signal crosses from the Codex plugin to Slack, but new public Plugin SDK calls are compatibility-sensitive and the discussion contains no clear owner approval of this API direction.

options.title: Approve generic SDK contract
options.body: Keep the generic public kind and predicate after the Slack block-path defect is fixed and focused compatibility coverage is added.

options.title: Use internal runtime seam
options.body: Carry the typed signal through an internal injected/runtime contract without expanding the external Plugin SDK.

options.title: Pause and redesign
options.body: Defer this branch if maintainers do not want a permanent shared progress-intent contract.

recommendation.title: Approve generic SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep the generic public kind and predicate after the Slack block-path defect is fixed and focused compatibility coverage is added.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Slack ordered delivery pipeline is tied to their recent merged work, making them the clearest available owner for the affected cross-path behavior decision.
